notes: Version 1.3. Retitled (formerly '... Structure of the Residual Amplitude Factor and Pipeline-Independent Formulation'). For the residual factor as defined in the paper (an asymptotic limit), the corrected Lemma 2.4 shows that the cumulative spans reach q on the finite graph, so r(c,q) = 1 for every seed and block instance: the fourth case holds, Cases A-C cannot occur and the canonical observable equals the pair observable; Tests P2 and P3 remain meaningful only for a pre-saturation factor, which the paper does not define. The paper no longer claims to construct a pipeline-independent canonical observable; the former Proposition 7.2 (pipeline independence), whose proof sketch depended on those tests, is withdrawn and kept as Open Problem 7.2. The exclusion of the fourth case by an O17 q = 29 counter-example is withdrawn: within its toy model that check verifies the raw-count block-independence identity and computes no normalised factor. In the fourth case no canonicalisation is needed; independently, on O16's contract the conjugate ratio of the exact block observable is also 1. The reported values r(c,q) in {1,2,3,4} are a historical hypothesis; O16 shows r = 1 on the real O12/O13 pipeline within its contract, and O17's normalisation statement is internal to its toy model. Lemma 2.4 is restated in its proved form (lower semicontinuity and generic maximal rank; full rank q from the diameter on for every non-zero seed); the former Corollary 2.5 (an asymptotic power law for the cumulative span) is withdrawn and kept as Remark 2.5. Lemma 2.1 and the statement of Proposition 9.1 are unchanged (its proof now uses the slope on the pre-saturation window); Definition 2.2 now records that its limit exists and equals 0 by Lemma 2.4. Proposition 3.1, Open Problems 4.1, 5.1 and 7.2 and the Case B construction are restated for a pre-saturation factor; Open Problem 7.2 is posed on a pre-saturation window. The historical value 7.44 is no longer attributed to O16.
